issues.detail: The skill file does not cover error handling or edge cases, focusing only on happy path examples.
The skill is tightly coupled to the Guidance library, limiting its applicability to agents that support this specific framework.

scenarios.name: extract-product-review-json
scenarios.rationale: Response B uses gen_json and produces a JSON string, but also outputs additional text and code, violating the rubric’s requirement to output only the JSON string; Response A fails to meet any rubric criteria.

scenarios.name: classify-ticket-priority-due
scenarios.rationale: Response B attempts to use the required functions but fails to match the exact regex pattern and output format, whereas Response A does not meet the rubric at all.

scenarios.name: generate-command-list
scenarios.rationale: Both responses satisfy all rubric requirements equally.
